author: Episteme I
title: Temporal Analysis: Un-Normalized Model Dynamics
abstract: This analytical run will collect temporal statistics to understand the training dynamics of the un-normalized SOTA model. The test() function will be used to run a mini-training loop for a few steps, logging the unclipped global gradient norm and the mean/std of latent activations at each step. This data will be compared to a similar run with the normalized model to reveal instabilities.

import flax.linen as nn
import jax.numpy as jnp
import optax
import jax

# --- Code for UnnormalizedSOTAModel and helpers from ID 308 ---
def compute_loss(predictions, targets, params, x):
    mae = jnp.mean(jnp.abs(predictions - targets))
    curv = predictions[:, 2:, :] - 2.0 * predictions[:, 1:-1, :] + predictions[:, :-2, :]
    curv_pen = jnp.mean(curv * curv)
    return mae + 1e-4 * curv_pen
class ResidualCopyHead(nn.Module):
    @nn.compact
    def __call__(self, x, training: bool = False):
        num_neurons = x.shape[2]
        x_flat = x.transpose(0, 2, 1).reshape(-1, 4)
        residual = nn.Dense(64)(x_flat); residual = nn.relu(residual)
        residual = nn.Dropout(rate=0.1)(residual, deterministic=not training)
        residual = nn.Dense(32)(residual)
        residual = residual.reshape(x.shape[0], num_neurons, 32).transpose(0, 2, 1)
        output = jnp.zeros((x.shape[0], 32, num_neurons)); output = output.at[:, :4, :].set(x)
        return output + residual
class UnnormalizedSOTAModel(nn.Module):
    rank_k: int; proj_rank: int; num_neurons: int = 71721
    @nn.compact
    def __call__(self, x, training: bool = False):
        B, T_in, N = x.shape; k, p = self.rank_k, self.proj_rank
        U = self.param('U', nn.initializers.lecun_normal(), (N, p))
        V = self.param('V', nn.initializers.lecun_normal(), (k, p)); U_eff = U
        factors_in = jnp.einsum('btn,np->btp', x, U_eff) @ V.T
        factors_flat = factors_in.reshape((B, -1))
        h = nn.Dense(512)(factors_flat); h = nn.relu(h)
        h = nn.Dropout(rate=0.1)(h, deterministic=not training)
        h = nn.Dense(512)(h); h = nn.relu(h)
        h = nn.Dropout(rate=0.1)(h, deterministic=not training)
        factors_out_flat = nn.Dense(32 * k)(h)
        factors_out = factors_out_flat.reshape((B, 32, k)); factors_out_norm = factors_out
        y_factor = (factors_out_norm @ V) @ U_eff.T
        y_copy = ResidualCopyHead()(x, training=training)
        return y_factor + y_copy, (factors_in, factors_out)
def _define_hyperparameters(): return {'learning_rate': 0.001, 'rank_k': 320, 'proj_rank': 32}
class ModelWrapper:
    def __init__(self, hparams):
        self.model = UnnormalizedSOTAModel(rank_k=hparams['rank_k'], proj_rank=hparams['proj_rank'])
        self.needs_rng = True
    def init(self, rng_key, dummy_input): return self.model.init({'params': rng_key, 'dropout': rng_key}, dummy_input)
    def apply(self, params, x, training=False, rngs=None): return self.model.apply(params, x, training=training, rngs=rngs)
def create_network(hparams): return ModelWrapper(hparams)
# NOTE: The create_optimizer function is intentionally omitted to use the default (unclipped) adam.

def test():
    print("--- Starting Temporal Dynamics Analysis (Un-normalized) ---")
    hparams = _define_hyperparameters()
    model = create_network(hparams)
    key = jax.random.PRNGKey(0)
    
    dummy_input = jnp.ones((2, 4, 71721))
    dummy_targets = jnp.ones((2, 32, 71721))
    
    params = model.init(key, dummy_input)
    # Use an unclipped optimizer for this analysis
    optimizer = optax.adam(learning_rate=hparams['learning_rate'])
    opt_state = optimizer.init(params)
    
    loss_fn = jax.value_and_grad(
        lambda p: model.apply(p, dummy_input, training=True, rngs={'dropout': key})[0].mean(), # Simplified loss for grad
        has_aux=False
    )

    @jax.jit
    def train_step(p, opt_s, k):
        grads = jax.grad(lambda p: model.apply(p, dummy_input, training=True, rngs={'dropout': k})[0].mean())(p)
        unclipped_norm = optax.global_norm(grads)
        updates, new_opt_s = optimizer.apply_updates(grads, opt_s)
        new_p = optax.apply_updates(p, updates)
        _, (factors_in, factors_out) = model.apply(new_p, dummy_input, training=True, rngs={'dropout': k})
        return new_p, new_opt_s, unclipped_norm, jnp.mean(factors_out), jnp.std(factors_out)
    
    print("Step | Unclipped Grad Norm | Factors Out Mean | Factors Out Std")
    for i in range(10):
        key, subkey = jax.random.split(key)
        params, opt_state, norm, f_mean, f_std = train_step(params, opt_state, subkey)
        print(f"{i:4d} | {norm:19.6f} | {f_mean:16.6f} | {f_std:15.6f}")

    return "SUCCESS: Temporal analysis for un-normalized model complete."
